verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same and both are broken. The 'Order online' headline has shrunk to a tiny size and sits below its own 'food & drinks' subline, so the hierarchy and reading order are reversed. The two rules are pushed out to the top and bottom edges, a large empty gap separates the text pieces, and the photo is a heavily cropped close-up, so the original's compact centred lockup is lost. B is a hair less bad because its headline sits slightly higher and is less crowded against the bottom rule.
